Rene Coig renecoig@uw.edu

Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
```
Read in data
```{r,read in raw data}
Pupae <- read.csv("TDO 072023/TDO Pupation.csv")
Pupae$group<-factor(Pupae$group, levels=c('TDO 2.5mM', 'TDO 5mM', 'TDO 10mM'))
Pupae$NormHeigh<-Pupae$PupalHeight/Pupae$FinalPupae
TDOHighPupae<-Pupae%>%filter(group=="TDO 10mM")
TDOMidPupae<-Pupae%>%filter(group=="TDO 5mM")
TDOLowPupae<-Pupae%>%filter(group=="TDO 2.5mM")
DMSOPupae<-Pupae%>%filter(Treatment=="DMSO")
```

```{r}
p <- ggboxplot(Pupae, x = "Treatment", y = "PupalHeight",
          color = "Treatment", palette = c("purple", "black"),
          add = "jitter")+
  facet_wrap(~group)+
  ylab("Pupal Height")+
  ggtitle("Pupal Height by Treatment, w[1118]")
#  Add p-value
p + stat_compare_means()

p <- ggboxplot(Pupae, x = "Treatment", y = "NormHeigh",
          color = "Treatment", palette = c("purple", "black"),
          add = "jitter")+
  facet_wrap(~group)+
  ylab("Average Pupal Height")+
  ggtitle("Pupal Height by Treatment, w[1118]")
#  Add p-value
p + stat_compare_means()

p <- ggboxplot(Pupae, x = "Treatment", y = "PupationRate",
          color = "Treatment", palette = c("purple", "black"),
          add = "jitter")+
  facet_wrap(~group)+
  ylab("Pupation Rate")+
  ggtitle("Pupation Rate by Treatment, w[1118]")
#  Add p-value
p + stat_compare_means()

p <- ggboxplot(DMSOPupae, x = "Color", y = "PupalHeight",
          color = "black",
          add = "jitter")+
  #facet_wrap(~group)
  ggtitle("Pupal Height by DMSO %")
#  Add p-value
p + stat_compare_means()

p <- ggboxplot(DMSOPupae, x = "Color", y = "PupationRate",
          color = "black", #palette = c("purple", "black"),
          add = "jitter")+
  #facet_wrap(~group)
  ggtitle("Pupation Rate by DMSO %")
#  Add p-value
p + stat_compare_means()
```
ANOVAS
```{r}
summary(aov(PupalHeight ~ Color, data = DMSOPupae))
summary(aov(NormHeigh ~ Color, data = DMSOPupae))
summary(aov(PupationRate ~ Color, data = DMSOPupae))

```
